outcome: Alx at a heart rate of 75 beats per minute (Alx-75)
cohort: The study included 46 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with preeclampsia and 46 normotensive pregnant women as controls.
finding: Pulse wave velocity (PWV) and augmentation index at a heart rate of 75 beats per minute (Alx-75) were significantly higher in pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia compared to normotensive pregnancies, and also higher in early-onset preeclampsia compared to late-onset preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: Measurements were performed during pregnancy, between 2014 and 2019, after diagnosis of preeclampsia or during normotensive pregnancy.
gest_age: Gestational age was used to classify preeclampsia as early-onset (<34 weeks) or late-onset (>=34 weeks).
